basic_info.description: This newly renovated luxury building offers a rarely available house-like 2 lvl 3BR/3.5BA condo w/private yard, elevator & custom finishes throughout. Ideal location close to shops, restaurants & public transportation. Home offers spacious Chef's kitchen w/stainless steel appliances including Miele gas range, Fisher & Paykel bottom freezer built-in fridge, Dish Drawer and wine refrigerator. Floor to ceiling custom cabinetry, large Silestone counter island w/waterfall edge & seating for four. Light-filled open plan living/dining w/built-in linear gas burning fireplace. Luxe Master Bath w/shower & soaking tub. Guest room w/bath down opens to huge Ipe deck & yard, perfect for entertaining. Radiant heat & 2 car pkg! One Seller is licensed Broke
